title: Reframing a loop-call configuration
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be finite Boolean Turing machines, let $a$ be a state of $B$, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $c$ be a configuration of $B$ on $x$. Choose Boolean values $s,s',r,r'$, optional Boolean symbols $u,u'$, Boolean words $w,w'$, a configuration $f$ of $F$ on $x$, and an optional state $q$ of $B$. The configuration obtained by reframing the loop-call configuration built from $B,F,a,s,c,r,u,w,f$, using the state of the loop-call configuration built from $B,F,a,s',c[q],r',u',w',f$, the input-head position of $c$, tape contents $u'$ only at cell $0$, buffer tapes storing $w'$ and the output of $c$, head positions $0$ and the length of $c$'s output, and empty output, is exactly the loop-call configuration built from $B,F,a,s',c[q],r',u',w',f$, where $c[q]$ denotes $c$ with its state replaced by $q$.
